name: xguard-monorepo
description: XGuard: safety and health-aware facilitator routing for x402 v2

scripts.adoption:self-test: node scripts/adoption-engine.mjs --self-test && node scripts/adoption-targets.mjs --self-test && node scripts/conversion-engine.mjs --self-test && node scripts/migration-engine.mjs --self-test
scripts.adoption:scan: node scripts/adoption-engine.mjs && node scripts/adoption-targets.mjs && node scripts/conversion-engine.mjs && node scripts/migration-engine.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:worker && npm run adoption:self-test && npm run security:secrets && npm run quality:no-todos && npm run quality:docs && npm run build
scripts.verify:release: npm run check && npm run security:deps && npm --workspace @xguard/worker run types -- --check && npm --workspace @xguard/worker run build && npm --workspace @xguard/worker run build:mainnet && npm --workspace @xguard/worker run build:economic-preview && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @xguard/core && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @xguard/sdk && npm pack --dry-run --workspace xguard
scripts.verify:mainnet-release: npm run check && npm run security:deps && npm --workspace @xguard/worker run types -- --check && npm --workspace @xguard/worker run build:mainnet && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @xguard/core && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @xguard/sdk && npm pack --dry-run --workspace xguard
